Playbook.name: Oracle — New Principal Performing a Privileged Operation - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: A principal not seen before (new_terms) performed a privileged Oracle operation (DELETE/TRUNCATE/ALTER SYSTEM/CREATE DB LINK). Triage: a new/compromised DB account performing privileged actions, or a newly-onboarded legitimate account?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: A new principal performing privileged DB operations may be a compromised or attacker-created account.

LogSources.LogSource: Oracle DB audit via apps-* - apps-*

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Oracle DB audit in apps-* (verified live). Fields: ACTION_NAME, USERNAME, SQL_TEXT, plus the audited object. Rules exclude known service principals (e.g. INH_LIFE, BANKSYS, JCB_AML). The acting principal is USERNAME.

Signal.Name: New Principal Performing a Privileged Op
Signal.Details: first-seen principal performing a privileged Oracle op.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the new privileged principal is a compromised/rogue account or a legitimate new account.

Step.name: The new principal's privileged operations
Step.Purpose: What privileged operations the new principal performed, and on what, sets the risk.
Step.Query: FROM apps-* | WHERE USERNAME == "$username" AND ACTION_NAME IN ("DELETE","TRUNCATE TABLE","ALTER SYSTEM","CREATE PUBLIC DATABASE LINK") AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, ACTION_NAME, SQL_TEXT | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 20
Step.AnalystNotes: Destructive/exfil operations (TRUNCATE, DB link) by a brand-new principal are high-risk. A new DBA/app account performing expected setup is lower-risk. Read SQL_TEXT.

Node.Condition: A new principal performing destructive/exfil operations (TRUNCATE/DB link/ALTER SYSTEM) with no onboarding record.
Node.Result: True Positive (Rogue/Compromised DB Account - escalate, disable)

Node.Condition: A newly-onboarded legitimate DBA/app account performing expected operations.
An application using a new service account (baseline gap).

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-ORANEW-OPS to the case.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm onboarding; baseline; close as false_positive.

TruePositive.Definition: A rogue or compromised DB account.

SOCAction.Item: Disable the account; review data impact; open IR.

Misconfiguration.Definition: An app using an unbaselined service account.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Identify the new principal and its operations; confirm onboarding.
If rogue, disable and review data impact.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Disable the account; review affected data; open IR.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Enforce DB account onboarding governance; alert on new privileged principals.

QualityChecks.Check: new_terms keys on USERNAME; the privileged action set is DELETE/TRUNCATE/ALTER SYSTEM/CREATE DB LINK.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Rogue account disabled; data impact reviewed; IR recorded.
